data.narrative:
Addionics is a Series B climate and energy company that has raised $39M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 9 private and 1 public company operating in the same sector and stage window, including KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Amogy.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the $39M raised as a value proxy and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, implies a valuation of $74M. Peer-median analysis across the three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—KoBold Metals ($3.0B, Series C), Electric Hydrogen ($1.0B, Series C), and Amogy ($700M, Series C)—yields a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $700M to $3.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $63M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $537M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around stage-adjusted multiples in the frontier climate-tech sector, where peer valuations diverge significantly and limited public comparables constrain calibration. Stage progression assumes Addionics will track typical venture progression mechanics; peer-median relies on adjacency assumptions given the absence of exact-stage matches. Reconciling this range requires clarity on Addionics' product maturity, capital efficiency relative to peers, and market timing for the next financing event.
